name: Overseas Korean Visa
description: The F-4 visa is for ethnic Koreans (교포) who hold foreign citizenship. It provides long-term residence and work authorization for overseas Koreans returning to or visiting their ancestral homeland.
tagline: Return to Korea as an overseas Korean

workPermission.notes: Most professional and skilled work allowed

pathsTo.name: Professional Employment Visa
pathsTo.requirements: Secure a professional job offer from a Korean company. F-4 holders may need E-7 for specific employer sponsorship or regulatory requirements.
pathsTo.notes: F-4 already provides broad work rights, so E-7 transition is less common. Usually only needed for specific corporate or regulatory requirements.

pathsTo.name: Residence Visa
pathsTo.requirements: Meet F-2 eligibility through ethnic Korean status or points-based system (F-2-7, 80+ points).
pathsTo.notes: F-4 holders may transition to F-2 as a stepping stone toward F-5 permanent residence. F-2 provides additional stability and broader residence rights.
